Ingredients: 1 cup Eggland’s Best Liquid Egg Whites (cholesterol-free and pasteurized!) 1½ cups rolled oats 1 banana 2 tbsp honey or maple syrup 1 tsp vanilla extract 1 tsp baking powder ½ tsp cinnamon ¼ tsp salt (optional) cholate chips on top  1.  Preheat oven to 350 F  2.  Blend all ingredients until mostly smooth  3.  Pour into muffin cups (¾ full)  4.  Add chocolate chips  5.
